> Feeling a bit pigeonholed this past week on how to move forward with my blyg, especially with the 0.4 changes. As I’m starting to feel the limitations of my mobile client, noticing my energy sapping toward extending blyxt further when I’d rather direct my attention toward capturing more complex thoughts that the medium of Blygger affords.

Since blyxt uses telegram as an interface I think it’s going to be fundamentally limited. Probably best for quick notes?

One possible direction is to run a persistent agent on the server end and use telegram to tell it what to do rather than trying to do it directly.
content_html:
Feeling a bit pigeonholed this past week on how to move forward with my blyg, especially with the 0.4 changes. As I’m starting to feel the limitations of my mobile client, noticing my energy sapping toward extending blyxt further when I’d rather direct my attention toward capturing more complex thoughts that the medium of Blygger affords.

Since blyxt uses telegram as an interface I think it’s going to be fundamentally limited. Probably best for quick notes?

One possible direction is to run a persistent agent on the server end and use telegram to tell it what to do rather than trying to do it directly.
